title: ManagedSpaConfig
description: Configuration schema for Managed Modern Web SPA development server supervision in ReplayFix v1.3.0

toolchain.description: Detected SPA framework or build toolchain

working_dir.description: Working directory of the spawned dev server process (scratch clone)

command.description: Executable and arguments spawned to boot the dev server

port.description: Dynamically assigned ephemeral TCP port bound by the OS kernel

url.description: Full base HTTP URL where the SPA dev server is listening

readiness_path.description: HTTP path polled to confirm server compilation readiness

readiness_timeout_ms.description: Maximum allowed milliseconds before failing closed on dev server warmup

process_id.description: Root process identifier for child process tree supervision
